profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary: I’m a full-stack developer focused on building intelligent, accessible web applications powered by modern .NET technologies and Azure AI. I specialize in integrating large language models (LLMs), Azure AI Search, and OpenAI services into real-time, user-facing experiences—like streaming chat interfaces, smart search, and adaptive content generation. With a strong foundation in Blazor, ASP.NET Core, and SQL Server, I bridge traditional enterprise architecture with cutting-edge AI capabilities. Whether it’s orchestrating prompt logic, embedding vector search, or tuning performance for streaming APIs, I thrive at the intersection of AI innovation and product usability.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Full-stack developer specializing in modern .NET-based web applications with a strong focus on performance, accessibility, and seamless integration with Azure services. I design, build, and optimize distributed systems that support customer engagement platforms, internal tools, and AI-driven experiences.

Technical Highlights:

Built modern, component-driven UIs using Blazor Server, Blazor WebAssembly, and Angular 10, integrated with REST APIs and .NET Core backends.

Designed and maintained APIs using ASP.NET Core, including real-time streaming endpoints using text/event-stream for LLM-based chat interfaces.

Integrated Azure OpenAI and Azure AI Search, including embedding-based retrieval, prompt orchestration, and streaming responses for enhanced UX.

Implemented Azure Maps to deliver location-aware features, including real-time vendor proximity mapping, clustering logic, and WCAG-compliant interactive pins.

Centralized API logic with HttpClientFactory and clean service layers to promote reuse, testability, and resilience.

Authored complex SQL Server queries, optimized stored procedures, and created ad hoc reporting tools to serve both internal ops and executive insights.

Developed internal tools and dashboards for customer support, operations, and marketing teams—focusing on usability and maintainability.

Ensured WCAG 2.1 AA conformance across customer-facing platforms, including screen reader support, ARIA compliance, and keyboard accessibility.

Automated feedback logging and analytics via Application Insights for AI/LLM interaction tracking and system performance diagnostics.

Prototype-focused mindset—frequently spearheading experiments with AI, mapping, or UI improvements and converting validated ideas into production-grade features.

Provided cross-functional IT support and legacy system upkeep, with a deep understanding of the full product lifecycle and infrastructure.

projects.title: Stock Lookup
projects.description: This is an Angular project that runs on node and express. The purpose is to look up stock tags via third party api and return information about them.

projects.title: Coding Dojo MEAN Stack Final Exam
projects.description:
This was the final exam for the MEAN stack (MongoDB, Express, Angular, Node). I scored a 9.9 out of 10.

This goal of this project was to create a simple trivia game where users could login, add questions, play a game, post a score, and view a scoreboard.
